repo.name: Family Planz
repo.description: The official Family Planz app repository. Shared calendar, tasks, and groceries that keep your family on one page. Same app as https://familyplanz.com.

en-US.description:
👪 Family Planz keeps your family on the same page — everything happening today, everything that needs doing, and everything to pick up on the way home. Mom and Dad plan the week; the kids always know what's due. SHARED FAMILY CALENDAR
  • Family events the whole household sees, with repeating schedules, times, and locations
  • RSVP so everyone knows who is coming
  • One calendar for the family: planning stays together, not split across apps
TASKS THAT ACTUALLY MOVE
  • Priorities and due dates, so the important work is sorted first
  • Hand a task to another family member — they accept or decline, and it lands on their list
  • Completion history, so "did that happen?" has an answer
DAY DASHBOARD
  • Today's events, the Top-3 Priorities for the family, and the Family Task Board on one screen — a good start to the day at breakfast.
GROCERIES
  • A check-off list sorted the way you shop — by store
  • The app remembers which store you buy each item at and orders the list accordingly
  • Checked-off items step aside until the next shopping run
QUICK ADD
  • Type a sentence and the app fills the form for you — you always confirm before it saves
AND ON THE WEB
  • Family Planz also runs in the browser — family data travels with the family account, on phones and computers alike.
